title: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
hook_text: Microsoft is offering buyouts to 60,000 workers
script:
Microsoft just offered voluntary exit packages to 60,000 employees.
Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella is shifting the company focus toward AI.
The buyout offers reached staff located across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada.
This move signals how artificial intelligence is permanently shrinking corporate headcounts.
Workers now face hard choices as software handles tasks once done by humans.
Would you trade your job for an AI buyout?
